findings.title: Admission date mismatch between claim form and hospital bill
findings.detail: The claim form states an admission date of 01/12/2024, whereas the hospital bill and discharge summary record the admission date as 05 Dec 2024.

findings.title: Discharge date mismatch between claim form and hospital records
findings.detail: The claim form lists the discharge date as 08/12/2024, but the hospital bill total is calculated differently from the claim form amount claimed.

findings.title: Patient name mismatch on pharmacy invoice
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice lists the patient name as Vrinda Patel, whereas all other documents record the patient name as Vrinda Sha.
